analysis.overall: You spent 87% of the day in range with a very smooth night and morning. Aside from a stubborn high early yesterday afternoon, your treatments and meals were managed smoothly without significant spikes or severe lows.

events.title: Stubborn afternoon high
events.description: After an initial high of 222 mg/dL, glucose hovered around 190–202 mg/dL for nearly two hours despite multiple small corrections before finally returning to range around 4:00 PM.

events.title: Well-managed dinner response
events.description: Dosing for dinner carbs in two batches kept your post-meal peak to a modest 171 mg/dL, returning smoothly to 104 mg/dL by late evening.

events.title: Early morning floor dip
events.description: Glucose drifted down during the early hours and touched 70 mg/dL, but held steady at the lower boundary without crashing.

events.title: Remarkably flat breakfast curve
events.description: A 5u dose for 60g of carbs kept your glucose virtually flat around 100–109 mg/dL throughout the entire morning.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Take note of your breakfast pre-bolus timing today—dosing 5u for 60g carbs resulted in an almost perfectly flat line.
